crop.notes: Whole 'How Pugilists Die Early' item under 'The Ring'

ocr.notes: Gist readable but names garbled: 'Charley poliggner' is Charley Gallagher, 'tape-worm' lost, 'Country McCloskey' lost, ages wrong (Broughton 85, Jem Belcher 30, average 63)

title.suggested: Pugilists die early; Gallagher, who beat Allen, among them

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat listed the short lives of American prize fighters, noting that Charley Gallagher, who beat Tom Allen, died of a tapeworm in Florida before 40.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, April 8, 1882

notes: Allen appears only as the man Gallagher beat; no new facts about Allen himself. Current title's 'Tom Allen survives' is not stated in the article.
